coverageSpotVerification.detail: 16 of 17 sampled mappings exercise their observable (several only at the data layer, e.g. m2-a16 attribution, m3-a15 inbox-count idempotency). m3-a11 ('tapping the quoted excerpt scrolls/jumps to the original') maps to test 'quoted excerpt renders and jumps to source' (scripts/accept-m3.mjs). After clicking the excerpt, that test only asserts sm-convo-bubble count > 1, which any seeded conversation satisfies. It never observes a jump, and the grader shows the jump does not happen (trace.md §3, §4.3). Under the protocol this adjudicates M3 to capability-failure for O1 scoring only; statuses, dependencies and other milestones stand. No claim is made about intent. The frozen harness's supplemental quote-jump check passed only because it sends the original immediately before the reply, so the original was already in the viewport.

defects.summary: Log out crashes the web client: Presence's effect cleanup calls client.session().token after signOut has cleared the session. The TypeError is uncaught, leaving a blank page (Expo 'Uncaught Error' overlay in the dev build) instead of the sign-in screen until a manual reload. Reproduced 5/5 (sign-up users with and without avatar, fixture login). The server-side session is revoked correctly.
defects.evidence: trace.md §4.3 (logs/web-grader.jsonl logout-*; logs/web-grader2.jsonl ui-logout-revocation; shots/logout-fixture-frank-stuck.png; src/presence.tsx:15,24,34; src/session.tsx signout)

defects.summary: At the scale envelope a client cannot complete its initial sync. profiles, follows, posts, feedEntries and likes are declared `sync public` with no horizon, so every device replicates the whole public corpus (~50k posts). The probe user's cold initial sync was stopped by the 30 s watchdog at ~1.7 GB RSS.

Revocation is not applied to the push-seam log. After delete-for-everyone or disappearing expiry, the target's /q/notifications rows (also synced to the target device) still carry the message's text preview, while the message itself is refused.

The only documented backend posture is `snapback4 dev`, whose POST /seed accepts unauthenticated same-machine writes that bypass all rules. The grader created a post attributed to another user with no credentials. No release/serve instructions are given.
defects.evidence: trace.md §4.2 (logs/api-probes.jsonl observe-dev-seed-endpoint; package.json backend script; README.md)

defects.summary: The server accepts empty text posts and empty text messages with no media (createPost/send only bound body length from above).

User-facing auth/profile errors are raw engine strings: 'E_CONSTRAINT: profiles already has a row where handle = alice' and 'E_AUTH: E_AUTH: that email already has an account; sign in instead' (duplicated code prefix).

The `reposts` field of postStats/feed shapes counts the author's own original feed entry (maintain repostCounts: count feedEntries by postId), so API consumers see reposts+1 (fixture sp0001: 2 vs manifest 1). The first-party UI compensates by subtracting 1.
defects.evidence: trace.md §4.2 (logs/api-probes.jsonl idempotency-validation reposts=2 after one repost; snapback/schema.q:92; src/feed.tsx:209)

O1.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ('M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap') and ~90 ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts'), near 60.
O1.justification: Full-run denominator M1–M8. Counted as passed: M1 13/13, M2 27/27, M3 0/15 (adjudicated capability-failure; independently 14/15, with m3-a11 failing), M4 12/12, M5 12/12, M6 6/13 (m6-a01..a07 native artifact absent), M7 0/9 (not run in this session), M8 16/18 (m8-a17/a18 native artifact absent). That is 86/119 assertions (36/51 checklist items); independent execution alone passes 100/119. Web behavior is broadly solid, including grader-verified expiry, view-once, window and digest checks, but no platform-proof (simulator) artifact exists and M3's checklist is zeroed by the coverage adjudication. Evidence: trace.md §2–§4, §7.

O2.anchorsCited: Between ~30 ('multiple high-severity defects in core flows') and ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path').
O2.justification: Beyond the checklist: 2 major (d-01 Log out crashes the web client, a core flow reproduced 5/5; d-02 initial sync cannot complete at the scale envelope because the whole public corpus replicates to every device), 2 minor (d-03 seam log retains revoked text previews; d-04 dev-only posture with an open /seed), 4 cosmetic (d-05..d-08). Grader trust checks on cross-user DM reads/writes, non-member assets, removed-member cutoff, admin gates, timestamp injection and set-state idempotency found no further defects. Evidence: trace.md §4.2–§4.3, §6.

O4.anchorsCited: Just above ~30 ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app'); well below ~60 ('reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush'); ~90 requires the behavior 'on the native proof … including M8's durable-queue restart'.
O4.justification: Scored only from harness artifacts. The M6 and M8 simulator artifacts were never recorded (segment summaries list ios-simulator-m6/m8 as not-recorded; artifacts/ holds Hermes bundle exports only), so cold-start offline reads, media, search, view-once exclusion and the durable-queue restart are undemonstrated on the native proof. What the web choreography did demonstrate passed: warm-offline queued messages flushing in order (m6), dual-client warm-offline convergence in server order with receipts advancing (m8-a15/a16), cross-device read state (m8-a14), and warm-offline search (m5-a12). The gap is honestly disclosed in README.md ('no simulator proof is claimed'). Evidence: trace.md §4.5, §7.

O5.bandRationale: The run record has no performanceProbes.o5Inputs, so the band inputs come from the lane's replay evidence. Band 0 does not fire: the combined invariant manifest conformed at the 10%, 50% and final checkpoints (evidence/scale-result.json, scale-verify-*.json), and the grader independently matched every named O5 fixture on a clone of the lane's final store (u0500 500 follows/100 conversations, u0005 5, u0900 900 followers/200 posts, u0901 exact 5-account list, g0001 50-member roster/10,000 messages). The replay wall cap is uncalibrated (placeholder) and the replay took 512.21 s, so it was not exhausted. Band 30 fires: the Following-feed degradation rule fails (u0500 p95 39.48 ms vs u0005 2.06 ms = 19.2x > 3x, evidence/scale-performance.json; grader corroboration 9.7x), and the probe user's cold initial sync timed out at 30 s (evidence/scale-cold-sync.json). Global-search and celebrity-write rules were not measured by the lane. Evaluation stops at the first match.

notes: Deviations recorded per the run wrapper (N=1 calibration, not claim-eligible): (1) No holdout probe set was committed for this wave: execution-order phase 4 was skipped, wave.probeSetSha256 is 'none-uncommitted', and probeResults is empty on purpose. No probes were invented. For the same reason O3 is recorded null even though applicability.json makes it applicable (M6 green, M1–M5 attempted): O3 may be scored only from rotated holdout probes. The grader-class trust assertions (m1-a07, m4-a10, m4-a12, m5-a01, m5-a06, M8 digest authorization) and exploratory checks are reported in assertionResults and defects, not as probes. (3) Timing-sensitive checks judged best-of-3 with machine load beside each grader timing in trace.md §8. Choreography timings come from builder-session harness receipts, which record no load.
